title: indirect enum: Immutable Linked List
hints: An `indirect enum` can model an immutable linked list.
`prepending` wraps `self` in a new node; `reversed` folds the list into a new one; `AnyIterator` walks the nodes.
`guard case let .node(value, next) = current else { return nil }; current = next; return value`.
jsBridge: An immutable linked list as `indirect enum List<T>` is a persistent data structure: prepending shares the tail. That's like functional JS lists (Immutable.js `List`) but built into the type system.

compass.q: Why are linked lists rare in JS app code? Are they any more common in Swift?
